evidence: The method iterates CustomUnit.attachedUnits, checks each AttachmentSlot.showAllActionsFrom LogicBoolean, wraps child actions in UnitSpecificActionProxy, and appends them to the UI action list. It does not detach or clean a list.

CustomUnit constructor allocates eg; CustomUnit.getAttachedUnitActions clears and reuses it as the temporary list of actions exposed by AttachmentSlot.showAllActionsFrom. It is not a waypoint-action cache.

CustomUnit.dB iterates legRuntimeStates, sets fallingReset and needsPositionReset on each LegRuntimeState, then refreshes leg placement. The old markAttachmentsFalling name was inaccurate; this method only touches leg runtime states.
